item.title: DevFest is back!
item.description: DevFest 2026 runs from October 1 to December 31, bringing together nearly a million developers across more than 800 global events centered on the agentic AI era Under the theme "Build, Secure, Scale," participants gain hands-on experience with Google’s developer stack—including Gemini, Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, and Web MCP—through live workshops and codelabs The conference focuses on enabling developers to prototype rapidly, ensure secure and private deployments, and leverage production-ready infrastructure.

item.title: 4 real? Tracking exploitation and patching of eMudhra’s weak keys
item.description: Four, just four: that’s the key to break into any unpatched connection on the Internet that is using eMudhra certificates Here’s how we quickly patched Cloudflare, what evidence we can see of attempted exploitation, and how much of the rest of the Internet remains exposed.

item.title: Stripe on Stripe: What we learned moving $1B in vendor payments to Global Payouts
item.description: In early 2026, we began moving our vendor payments to Global Payouts, Stripe’s product for paying recipients in 160+ countries New-market setup fell from six weeks to one, with a 99.9% payout success rate
